rules.name: Facilitator Certification Threshold
rules.rejectionMessage: Facilitator certification score below minimum threshold of 80.

rules.name: Geofence Distance Verification
rules.rejectionMessage: Session GPS coordinates outside acceptable school boundary (>50m).

rules.name: Evidence Screenshot Clarity
rules.escalationMessage: Screenshot evidence quality below confidence threshold (0.70).

rules.name: Score Delta Plausibility
rules.escalationMessage: Learner score improvement exceeds plausible threshold (+50 points in single period).

rules.name: Roster Registration Check
rules.escalationMessage: Learner name or DID not found in initial enrolled project roster.
